name: Smart Materials & Artificial Muscles
summary: Active materials that move or sense, such as piezoelectrics, shape-memory alloys, electroactive polymers and fibre muscles, and how to design actuators with them.

topics.name: Survey of active materials and actuator figures of merit (strain, stress, bandwidth, efficiency)
Piezoelectric actuators and sensors: stack and bender design
Shape memory alloys: phase transformation, actuator design and control
Electroactive polymers: dielectric elastomers and ionic EAPs
Magnetostrictive, magnetorheological and electrorheological materials and devices
Comparison with biological muscle and implications for wearable actuators
